Exact Clone OT from a Disk-Backed Graph-Distance Store

Source: R/exact_ot_disk.R
graph_clone_ot_disk.Rd

Reads bounded cell-distance blocks from a binary store and applies the same unregularized clone_2_ot() calculation to every clone pair.

Usage

graph_clone_ot_disk(
  store,
  cell_clone_prob,
  prob_thresh = 0.05,
  target_cell_limit = 5000L,
  cores = 1L,
  checkpoint_dir = NULL,
  overwrite_checkpoint = FALSE,
  monitor = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

store

A completed clonotrace_distance_store object or its binary path.

cell_clone_prob

A numeric or sparse cell-by-clone membership matrix with named rows and columns.

prob_thresh

Membership values below this threshold are set to zero.

target_cell_limit

Approximate maximum number of unique target cells loaded in one cost block.

cores

Number of balanced source-clone partitions. Configure a future plan before using more than one.

checkpoint_dir

Optional directory for validated per-source checkpoints.

overwrite_checkpoint

Whether to recompute existing checkpoints.

monitor

Whether to attach timing and memory diagnostics.

verbose

Whether to report progress.

Value

A data frame with group1, group2, and exact OT dis.

Details

Parallel workers open independent read-only connections. Storage and data access differ from graph_clone_ot(), but the graph-Wasserstein objective and clone probability masses are unchanged.
